response.sql: WITH g AS (SELECT s.arcref AS arcref, p.fundflux AS fundflux, SUM(s.gbsize) * 1.0 / SUM(s.spanmin) AS rate FROM scans s JOIN projects p ON p.arcregistry = s.arcref GROUP BY s.arcref, p.fundflux), b AS (SELECT AVG(rate) AS bench FROM g) SELECT g.arcref, g.fundflux, g.rate, g.rate - b.bench AS excess FROM g, b WHERE g.rate > b.bench ORDER BY excess DESC LIMIT 10

assumptions.assumption: Groups whose total scan duration is zero or NULL have a NULL rate (SQLite returns NULL for division by zero). They are left out of the benchmark average and cannot exceed it.
The benchmark is the unweighted mean of the per-group rates, where each group is one (arcref, fundflux) pair. It is not a pooled overall rate.
SUM ignores NULL gbsize or spanmin values row by row.
